text:
Ben - Sales: Quick sync — HelixPay is ready to start a 6-week pilot. Need to lock POC success criteria, prioritized user journeys, and any enterprise blockers (security, pricing, infra). Kickoff tomorrow 10am.

Aisha (Solutions): Thanks — proposed top 3 journeys: 1) Transaction summarization for reconciliation UI, 2) Dispute triage + suggested next action, 3) KYC/AML risk flagging for edge cases. Prioritize #1 then #2.

Dmitri Eng: For infra: verify latency targets per endpoint before we propose Dedicated. Summaries are batch/near-realtime; want p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms on 512-context. Dispute triage can accept higher tail. Also need expected QPS to size GPUs.

Lina (Security): Send the HelixPay security questionnaire answers by EOD. Key asks: data residency for PII, retention policy, KMS usage, and whether tokens ever leave their VPC during Dedicated trial. Also need threat model for dispute classifier (false-positive handling).

Ben - Sales: HelixPay asks for an SSO-enabled demo and written answers for the questionnaire. They also want a pricing anchor for a 6-week pilot (incl. ~250k tokens/week + 2k embeddings/week). Any ballpark?

Tom (CSE): Ballpark for hosted: ~$2.5k/wk given current model choices; Dedicated estimate needs exact GPU sizing. We can propose a hybrid: Hosted baseline + short Dedicated burst windows for heavy evals.

Aisha (Solutions): Proposed POC timeline: Week 0: infra + security signoffs; Week 1: integration + sample prompts; Weeks 2-4: evals and tuning; Week 5: user acceptance tests with product team; Week 6: wrap + rollout plan.

Dmitri Eng: For sizing I'll need: expected concurrency (peak 20rps?), average request tokens, and cache hit assumptions. Also, provide sample prompt set ASAP so we can run cost simulations.

Ben - Sales: I'll ask HelixPay for concurrency and share prompt CSV by tomorrow.

Lina (Security): Quick checklist items I need before we greenlight: 1) dataflow diagram, 2) retention policy doc, 3) KMS proof-of-concept (if using Dedicated), 4) approved subprocessor list. If any of those are delayed, we push security review and that shifts timeline.

Aisha (Solutions): Minimal acceptance criteria I recommend (we can formalize in the SOW):
```
Acceptance criteria:
- Transaction-summary: median latency <= 150ms, p95 <= 400ms, precision >= 90% on curated reconciliation set (n=200)
- Dispute-triage: recall >= 88% and false positive rate <= 8% on labeled set (n=150)
- AML flagging: precision >= 80% with manual review fallback for flagged items; end-to-end latency for flagged flow <= 800ms
- Integration: SDK + 2 endpoints deployed in staging, smoke tests passing, and SSO demo recorded
- Security: completed questionnaire + KMS integration verified in staging
```

Tom (CSE): For prompts/evals I'll prepare 3 canonical prompt templates and an eval harness. Suggest 200 test prompts per endpoint and a pass threshold of 70% on the scoring rubric to call the POC successful.

Ben - Sales: Anything blocking that would stop us from committing to the Monday kickoff?

Dmitri Eng: Blockers: need the prompt CSV and concurrency numbers. If those arrive by EOD today we can hit Week 1 integration. Also confirm whether HelixPay will allow a small sample of production logs for prompt tuning (PII needs to be sanitized).

Lina (Security): Conditional approve for kickoff if they sign an NDA addendum and provide sanitized sample logs + dataflow diagram.

Aisha (Solutions): I'll draft the success criteria section for the SOW and a short-run pricing appendix. Will also include recommended model variants (low-latency quantized for summaries, higher-capacity for triage).

Ben - Sales: Great — I'll get back with HelixPay responses and share the CSV. ops-bot: reminder to create a pilot workspace and staging project once we confirm. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Created project "pilot-helixpay-1918765432" in staging, added Aisha, Dmitri, Tom, Lina, Ben.

Ben - Sales: Awesome, thanks all. I'll post HelixPay answers in this thread when I have them.
